# Flexport

> Flexport is a freight forwarder, customs broker, and fulfillment provider running AI-powered ocean, air, and trucking logistics with real-time visibility.

Flexport is a freight forwarder, customs broker, and fulfillment provider. It moves goods worldwide by ocean, air, and ground, clears customs, and runs fulfillment—giving businesses one place to see and control their supply chain from the factory floor to the customer's door.

This file indexes Flexport's site for language models: its products and solutions, and its editorial libraries—blog, case studies, glossary, help center, e-guides, webinars, global logistics updates, videos, and FlexU courses. Each link resolves to the full page in Markdown.

## Cargo Insurance for Ocean, Air & Trucking

- [Cargo Insurance for Ocean, Air & Trucking](https://www.flexport.com/products/cargo-insurance/index.md): Flexport Cargo Insurance covers loss, theft, and damage for ocean, air, and trucking shipments, with per-shipment or annual policy options and fast claims.
- [Cargo Insurance](https://www.flexport.com/products/cargo-insurance/offerings/index.md): Prepare for anything with Flexport cargo insurance. Learn more about our affordable cargo insurance options: umbrella policy or pay to insure by the shipment.

## Industries

- [Industries](https://www.flexport.com/industry/index.md): Purpose-built logistics solutions from Flexport. Explore how we deliver for semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, energy, fashion, consumer electronics, and every industry in between.
- [Automotive Logistics](https://www.flexport.com/industry/automotive-logistics/index.md): Streamline your automotive supply chain with Flexport. Temperature-controlled fulfillment, hazmat compliance, and AI-powered logistics for automotive brands.
- [Beauty & Personal Care Logistics](https://www.flexport.com/industry/beauty-logistics/index.md): Flexport helps beauty and personal care brands manage viral demand spikes with temperature-controlled fulfillment, Dangerous Goods certification for aerosols and fragrances, and AI-powered customs ent
- [Consumer Electronics Logistics](https://www.flexport.com/industry/consumer-electronics-logistics/index.md): Flexport handles consumer electronics logistics: lithium battery compliance, SKU-level tracking, AI-reviewed customs entries, and DDP/DDU shipping to 135+ countries.
- [Data Center Logistics](https://www.flexport.com/industry/data-center-logistics/index.md): Flexport's Center of Excellence for Data Center Logistics provides white glove handling, TAPA Level A security, dangerous goods certification, and AI-audited customs filing for hyperscale and enterpri
- [Secure, reliable global logistics for electronics](https://www.flexport.com/industry/electronics-logistics/index.md): Accelerate time-to-market for components and finished electronics with real-time visibility, allocation control, automated freight-to-fulfillment, and customs tools that help lower landed cost.
- [Energy Logistics](https://www.flexport.com/industry/energy-logistics/index.md): Flexport provides energy logistics for oversized equipment and project cargo: AI route planning, real-time shipment tracking, customs and tariff compliance including Duty Drawback, and ERP integration
- [Fashion & Apparel Logistics](https://www.flexport.com/industry/fashion-apparel-logistics/index.md): Flexport is a logistics platform for fashion and apparel brands, offering real-time SKU tracking, AI-driven freight optimization, customs brokerage, and returns management across 135+ countries.
- [Footwear Logistics Solutions](https://www.flexport.com/industry/footwear-logistics/index.md): Flexport gives footwear brands SKU-level shipment tracking, AI-driven freight optimization, and a global fulfillment network from factory to customer.
- [Global logistics built for home and furniture brands](https://www.flexport.com/industry/furniture-home-logistics/index.md): This page covers Flexport's logistics services for furniture and home-goods brands: handling bulky and fragile freight, planning for seasonal demand spikes, warehousing, customs brokerage, and trackin
- [Pharmaceutical Logistics](https://www.flexport.com/industry/pharmaceutical-logistics/index.md): Flexport gives pharmaceutical companies real-time shipment tracking via Control Tower, AI-powered freight cost optimization (avg. 10% savings), and customs compliance support (FDA, DEA, import licensi
- [Semiconductor Logistics Solutions](https://www.flexport.com/industry/semiconductor-logistics/index.md): Flexport moves semiconductors with TAPA Level A security, AI-audited customs filings, and real-time tracking, at 0.2% entry error rate vs. 2% industry average.
- [Toys & Games Logistics Solutions](https://www.flexport.com/industry/toys-games-logistics/index.md): Flexport handles toys and games logistics: Q4 demand planning, CPSC/ASTM compliance, HS code classification, and DDP/DDU fulfillment to 135+ countries.

## Content libraries

- [Blog](https://www.flexport.com/blog/llms.txt): Articles on global trade, ecommerce, and supply chain strategy—how freight, customs, and fulfillment work, and what shifting market conditions mean for the businesses that move goods.
- [Customer case studies](https://www.flexport.com/customers/llms.txt): How Flexport customers cut costs, scaled into new markets, and gained visibility across their supply chains, told through the results they achieved.
- [Logistics glossary](https://www.flexport.com/glossary/llms.txt): Plain definitions of freight, customs, and supply chain terms, from air waybills and Incoterms to anti-dumping duties, for anyone working in global logistics.
- [Videos](https://www.flexport.com/videos/llms.txt): Product demos and short explainers showing how Flexport brings your freight, customs, and inventory into one view across the supply chain.
- [Webinars](https://www.flexport.com/webinars/llms.txt): Recorded sessions on market conditions, customs and compliance, and supply chain planning, with Flexport specialists and industry guests.
- [Help center](https://www.flexport.com/help/llms.txt): Step-by-step answers for shippers: quoting and booking freight, preparing customs paperwork, delivering to Amazon FBA, and resolving common shipment questions.
- [Global logistics updates](https://www.flexport.com/global-logistics-update/llms.txt): Briefings on tariffs, trade policy, ocean and air capacity, and port conditions, what changed across major trade lanes and what it means for your shipments.
- [E-guides](https://www.flexport.com/eguides/llms.txt): In-depth guides to planning a resilient supply chain, from sourcing and forecasting to customs and new-market entry, for teams making bigger logistics decisions.
- [FlexU courses](https://www.flexport.com/flexu/llms.txt): Free short courses on the fundamentals of global trade, airfreight, customs, classification, bills of lading, and cargo insurance, taught one topic at a time.
- [Newsroom](https://www.flexport.com/company/newsroom/llms.txt): Flexport press releases, company and product announcements, funding and milestones, and media coverage—each links out to the release or the reporting outlet.

## Pages

- [2026 RFP Season Hub](https://www.flexport.com/resources/2026-rfp-hub/index.md): Resources for planning a logistics RFP—templates and expert guidance for evaluating and selecting a freight forwarder.
- [About Flexport | Global Trade & Logistics Platform](https://www.flexport.com/company/about-us/index.md): Flexport is a freight forwarder, customs broker, and fulfillment provider for 13,000+ brands in 135 countries, with AI-driven 99% on-time delivery.
- [Air Freight Forwarding & Air Cargo Shipping](https://www.flexport.com/products/air-freight/index.md): Flexport's air freight service pairs AI-native routing and planning with real-time tracking, charter capacity from Asia, and SKU-level landed cost visibility for shippers moving time-sensitive cargo.
- [Atlas: Explore Global Trade in Real Time](https://www.flexport.com/tools/atlas-overview/index.md): Atlas (atlas.flexport.com) is Flexport's free public map of global logistics: ports, carriers, vessel positions, route search, disruption monitoring, and route emissions. Core features need no login.
- [Sign Up for the Supply Chain Logistics Platform](https://www.flexport.com/atlas-sign-up/index.md): This page is Flexport's account sign-up form for its supply chain logistics platform, where new users register to start managing freight, costs, and workflows.
- [Audit Your Customs Broker | AI Tariff & Duty Review](https://www.flexport.com/audit-your-customs-broker/index.md): Flexport's AI audits 100% of customs entries vs. 5-10% industry avg - flagging HTS errors, tariff stacking, duty overpayments. $1B+ recovered for you.
- [Flexport B2B Fulfillment](https://www.flexport.com/products/b2b-fulfillment/index.md): Flexport is a one stop shop for your B2B logistics. Store upstream in our warehouses and distribute across the US.
- [Beat the Bottlenecks](https://www.flexport.com/resources/beat-the-bottleneck/index.md): Your Supply Chain Relies on You. Stay in Control. Beat the Bottlenecks.
- [Booking Management Software](https://www.flexport.com/products/booking-management/index.md): Flexport Booking Management is a centralized platform for managing ocean freight contracts and bookings across a shipper's full carrier network with real-time tracking.
- [Flexport Brand Guidelines](https://www.flexport.com/brand-guidelines/index.md)
- [Buyer's Consolidation | Cut Ocean Costs 10%](https://www.flexport.com/products/buyers-consolidation/index.md): Buyer's Consolidation combines multiple suppliers' purchase orders into one full ocean container, cutting freight costs by up to 10% and improving container utilization by 15% compared to standard LCL
- [Trade Financing & Working Capital | Flexport Capital](https://www.flexport.com/products/capital/index.md): Flexport Capital is Flexport's trade financing product: 120-day inventory/logistics loans, term loans, 24-hr duty drawback refunds, asset-based lending.
- [Careers at Flexport](https://www.flexport.com/careers/index.md): Flexport is hiring across engineering, operations, and more to build an AI-powered, autonomous platform for global trade. This page covers open roles, company culture, core values, and employee storie
- [Claim Tariff Refunds](https://www.flexport.com/solutions/claim-tariff-refunds/index.md): Claim Tariff Refunds
- [Freight Emissions Tracking & Offsets](https://www.flexport.com/products/climate/index.md): Flexport measures freight emissions with ISO 14083-certified data, cuts them with low-carbon fuels like SAF, and offsets residual Scope 3 emissions.
- [Company Code of Conduct](https://www.flexport.com/code-of-conduct/index.md): Flexport's Code of Conduct—the ethical and legal standards that govern how Flexport and its people do business.
- [Dangerous Goods Certifications](https://www.flexport.com/products/compliance-certification/index.md): Flexport offers IATA- and IMO-accredited dangerous goods certification for air and ocean shipping, plus program reviews and consultancy for compliance teams.
- [Contact Us](https://www.flexport.com/company/contact/index.md): How to reach Flexport—sales, support, and office contacts for questions about freight, customs, fulfillment, and your account.
- [Flexport Control Tower](https://www.flexport.com/technology/control-tower/index.md): Flexport Control Tower is a supply chain visibility platform offering booking management, order management, and supply chain optimization down to the SKU level. Flexport's early Control Tower customer
- [Flexport Reviews & Customer Stories](https://www.flexport.com/customer-success/index.md): Flexport helps 13,000+ brands — from emerging labels to the Fortune 100, including Everlane, Trek, and Bombas — ship, scale, and grow.
- [Customs Brokerage & Import Clearance Services](https://www.flexport.com/products/customs/index.md): Flexport Customs is a licensed customs brokerage that combines human brokers with AI to classify goods, calculate duties, and file entries, auditing 100% of entries before submission.
- [Customs Technology Suite](https://www.flexport.com/technology/customs-suite/index.md): Manage compliance risk and reduce costs with Flexport's Customs Technology Suite. AI-powered tools for broker auditing, tariff simulation, and refund calculation.
- [Refunds on Import-Export Duties](https://www.flexport.com/products/duty-drawback/index.md): Flexport's duty drawback service uses AI to match import and export data, helping U.S. importers and exporters recover up to 99% of duties, taxes, and fees under CBP rules. Flexport has returned over 
- [E-Commerce Fulfillment](https://www.flexport.com/solutions/e-commerce-fulfillment/index.md): E-Commerce Fulfillment
- [eCommerce Order Fulfillment Services](https://www.flexport.com/products/ecommerce-fulfillment/index.md): Flexport's eCommerce Fulfillment stores inventory across five U.S. fulfillment centers and ships orders in 1-2 days, integrating with Shopify, Amazon, Walmart, and 50+ other sales platforms.
- [Calculate Your Freight Emissions](https://www.flexport.com/emissions-calculator/index.md): Estimate the carbon emissions of a shipment by mode, weight, and distance with Flexport's freight emissions calculator.
- [Total control for global supply chains](https://www.flexport.com/solutions/enterprise/index.md): Total control for global supply chains
- [2025 Fall Release: New Customs & Tariff Tools](https://www.flexport.com/technology/product-release/fall-2025/index.md): Flexport's Fall 2025 release adds a Customs Technology Suite, Tariff Simulator Pro, and platform tools for tariffs, supply chain visibility, and fulfillment.
- [Free up the cash stuck in your inventory](https://www.flexport.com/solutions/finance-inventory/index.md): Free up the cash stuck in your inventory
- [Flexport AI, Technology Built for the Real World](https://www.flexport.com/technology/flexport-ai/index.md): Ask simple questions and receive immediate insights about your supply chain. Flexport’s Insight Builder can create reports and dashboards with no technical skills required, making it easy for business
- [Flexport MCP](https://www.flexport.com/technology/flexport-mcp/index.md): Flexport MCP is a Model Context Protocol server that connects a company's Flexport account to Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft 365 Copilot, or an internal AI tool, letting the assistant track shipments, get
- [Global Trade & Logistics Product](https://www.flexport.com/products/flexport-platform/index.md): The Flexport Platform gives supply chain teams real-time shipment tracking across every mode, instant ocean freight booking, AI-driven container optimization, and native integrations with NetSuite, SA
- [Freight Forwarder for Ocean, Air, Trucking, and Rail](https://www.flexport.com/lp/freight-forwarder-v2/index.md): Choose a freight forwarder specialised in handling daily and weekly ocean container freight and air freight shipping - powered by technology, infrastructure and expertise.
- [Sign Up for the Supply Chain Logistics Platform](https://www.flexport.com/get-started/index.md): Flexport's contact form for companies wanting a free consultation on cutting supply chain costs, automating logistics, or moving toward carbon-neutral shipping.
- [Global Logistics Network | 135+ Countries](https://www.flexport.com/company/global-network/llms.txt): Flexport's global network reaches 135+ countries (97% of global GDP) via ocean, air, rail, and truck, with 45+ offices and 60+ native ERP/marketplace integrations to run it all from one platform.
- [Fulfillment and Financing for Growing Brands](https://www.flexport.com/solutions/growing-brands/index.md): This page describes how Flexport helps startups and growing brands: Flexport Omnichannel is a five-warehouse US fulfillment network with 1-3 day delivery, returns processing, and a Seller Portal for i
- [Logistics for Electronics & Fashion - High Value](https://www.flexport.com/solutions/high-value-goods/index.md): Let the Flexport Platform make it faster and easier for you to manage high-stakes demand cycles for goods like electronics or fashion. Track logistics timing and make decisions on the fly with real ti
- [Impressum](https://www.flexport.com/impressum/index.md): Legal disclosure and company registration details for Flexport's European operations, as required under German law.
- [LCL Freight Shipping](https://www.flexport.com/products/less-than-container/index.md): Ship any amount of goods across the ocean with Less than Container load shipping solutions from Flexport, including OceanMatch.
- [Logistics Data Insights](https://www.flexport.com/solutions/logistics-data-insights/index.md): Logistics Data Insights
- [Official Flexport Logos — Download Brand Assets](https://www.flexport.com/company/logo/index.md)
- [Fulfillment for Amazon, Walmart & Marketplace Sellers](https://www.flexport.com/solutions/marketplace-sellers/index.md): Flexport fulfills orders for Amazon, Walmart, and other marketplace sellers from one shared inventory pool across five U.S. fulfillment centers, with FBA prep, Walmart WFS prep, and Amazon MCF include
- [Customs, Freight, and Financing for Multinational Brands](https://www.flexport.com/solutions/multinationals/index.md): Flexport gives multinational brands one platform for freight, customs brokerage, and trade financing across 135 countries, backed by in-house licensed brokerage in six markets and a vetted global part
- [Nonprofit & Humanitarian Logistics Solutions](https://www.flexport.com/solutions/nonprofit-organizations/index.md): Explains how Flexport.org, Flexport's humanitarian logistics team, ships aid and relief goods for nonprofits into complex, hard-to-reach destinations, backed by Flexport's ocean, air, trucking, and cu
- [Ocean Freight Forwarding](https://www.flexport.com/products/ocean-freight/index.md): Flexport Ocean Freight books FCL, LCL, and buyer's consolidation shipments, tracks containers in real time via the Flexport Platform, and uses AI to cut ocean freight costs by up to 10%.
- [Open Emissions Sign Up](https://www.flexport.com/open-emissions-signup/index.md): Sign up for Flexport's open emissions tracking and carbon accounting tools.
- [Cut Freight Costs with Supply Chain Optimization](https://www.flexport.com/solutions/optimize-supply-chain/index.md): Flexport's AI analyzes 12 months of your shipment history to find consolidation, mode-shift, and cost-saving opportunities, free and with no commitment.
- [Order Management](https://www.flexport.com/products/order-management/index.md): Flexport's Order Management centralizes purchase orders, supplier messages, and shipment milestones in one platform, helping customers eliminate 80% of shipment emails and 20 manual tasks per shipment
- [PAPS Customs Tracker](https://www.flexport.com/paps/index.md): Look up the U.S. customs status of a PAPS number for truck shipments arriving from Canada.
- [Parcel](https://www.flexport.com/products/parcel/index.md): Flexport's Parcel service lets ecommerce businesses purchase and print discounted shipping labels, then relies on Flexport's carrier network to pick up, sort, and deliver orders at speed.
- [PARS Customs Tracker](https://www.flexport.com/pars/index.md): Look up the Canadian customs (CBSA) status of a PARS or cargo-control number.
- [Business Partner Code of Conduct](https://www.flexport.com/partner-code-of-conduct/index.md): Flexport's Business Partner Code of Conduct—the compliance, integrity, and sustainability standards Flexport expects of suppliers, service providers, and agents.
- [Peak season preparation hub](https://www.flexport.com/resources/peak-season-2026-hub/index.md): Everything you need to know to successfully plan and execute your Peak season freight and fulfillment strategy. Stay up to date on key shipping deadlines, pricing and fees, best practices, and much mo

- [Privacy Notice](https://www.flexport.com/privacy/index.md): Flexport Privacy Notice.

- [Product Video Tutorials](https://www.flexport.com/resources/product-tutorials/llms.txt): See how our tech helps you accelerate performance for your entire supply chain, ship to and from anywhere, and track everything.
- [Protect Your Cargo | Flexport Cargo Insurance](https://www.flexport.com/solutions/protect-your-cargo/index.md): Flexport's Per Shipment Cargo Insurance is pay-as-you-go, all-risk coverage that protects shipments against loss, damage, or theft, with a $0 deductible, no annual commitment, and claims settling in 3
- [Tariff Refund Calculator](https://www.flexport.com/refunds/index.md): Our technology and team of customs experts provide the fastest, most accurate way to calculate your tariff refund amount and claim what you're owed.

- [Returns Management](https://www.flexport.com/products/returns/index.md): Flexport Returns inspects, restocks, and refunds customer returns within three business days, with automatic refund triggers once inspection matches the claim.
- [Cut Ocean Freight Costs by Up to 35%](https://www.flexport.com/solutions/save-money/index.md): Cut your freight costs without cutting corners
- [Vulnerability Disclosure Program](https://www.flexport.com/security/index.md): Flexport's Vulnerability Disclosure Program—how security researchers can report vulnerabilities and what to expect in response.
- [Omnichannel Seller Portal](https://www.flexport.com/solutions/seller-portal/index.md): Flexport's Omnichannel Seller Portal is a single platform for freight, warehousing, e-commerce and B2B fulfillment, replenishment, and returns.
- [Simplify Customs](https://www.flexport.com/solutions/simplify-customs/index.md): Simplify Customs
- [Streamline Returns](https://www.flexport.com/solutions/streamline-returns/index.md): Streamline Returns

Updates within 48 hours of official tariff changes. Free for up

- [Trade Advisory Services](https://www.flexport.com/products/trade-advisory/index.md): Flexport Trade Advisory pairs licensed customs experts with AI-driven ACE data analysis to classify goods correctly, minimize duties, and manage CTPAT, valuation, and post-summary correction programs.
- [Drayage & FTL Trucking Services](https://www.flexport.com/products/trucking/index.md): Flexport trucking covers drayage and FTL, moving containers port to warehouse with real-time visibility, nationwide capacity, and TMS integrations.
- [Unlock Retail Channels](https://www.flexport.com/solutions/unlock-retail-channels/index.md): Unlock Retail Channels
- [Supply Chain Visibility & Control Software](https://www.flexport.com/solutions/visibility-control/index.md): Flexport's Booking Management and Control Tower unify shipment tracking, carrier allocation, and performance data in one platform.
- [Walmart Order Fulfillment](https://www.flexport.com/products/walmart/index.md): Flexport accelerates your eCommerce sales with fast fulfillment and modern logistics
- [Fulfillment & Warehouse Network](https://www.flexport.com/products/warehouse-network/index.md): Flexport’s warehouse network stores inventory closer to customers across the US, Canada, and UK for faster, lower-cost shipping and easier demand planning.
- [Wholesale Distributor Logistics Solutions](https://www.flexport.com/solutions/wholesale-distributors/index.md): Explains how Flexport helps wholesale distributors pool DTC and B2B inventory, automate purchase orders, give suppliers booking control, and meet EDI and routing guide requirements for retail replenis
- [2025 Winter Release](https://www.flexport.com/technology/product-release/winter-2025/index.md): Winter Product and Technology Release
- [2026 Winter Release: New AI Agents for Customs & Freight](https://www.flexport.com/technology/product-release/winter-2026/index.md): Flexport's Winter 2026 release adds AI agents for customs audits, tariff refunds, and freight savings, plus AI search and translation on the Flexport Platform.

## Tools

- [Tariff Simulator](https://tariffs.flexport.com/): Calculate US import duties and customs fees by product or HTS code.
- [Tariff Refunds](https://tariffs.flexport.com/refunds): Check your imports for refundable IEEPA tariffs and start a claim.
- [Customs Broker Audit](https://tariffs.flexport.com/audit): Check your customs broker's entries for classification and compliance errors.
- [Flexport Atlas](https://atlas.flexport.com/): Track ocean vessels, port congestion, and sailing schedules on a live global map.

<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en" data-release="34769de27064c5a8537625c9edb1f412ff763d84" data-page-type="home" data-region="row"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Freight Forwarding & Supply Chain Platform | Flexport</title><link rel="preconnect" href="https://cdn.sanity.io"><script>
  (() => {
    const own = location.origin + "/_astro/";

    addEventListener(
      "error",
      ({ target: el }) => {
        if (
          el instanceof Element &&
          el.matches("link[rel~=stylesheet]") &&
          el.href.startsWith(own)
        ) {
          document.documentElement.dataset.cssError = "";
        }
      },
      true,
    );

    if (history.state?.assetReload) {
      history.replaceState({ ...history.state, assetReload: 0 }, "");

      return;
    }

    const probed = new Set();
    let leftAt = -Infinity;
    const recover = () => {
      const key = "asset-reload:" + document.documentElement.dataset.release;
      const wait = leftAt + 10000 - performance.now();

      if (wait > 0) {
        setTimeout(recover, wait);

        return;
      }

      try {
        if (sessionStorage.getItem(key) !== null) {
          return;
        }

        sessionStorage.setItem(key, "1");
      } catch {
        return;
      }

      history.replaceState({ ...history.state, assetReload: 1 }, "");
      location.reload();
    };
    const check = (url) => {
      const path = url?.split("?")[0];

      if (!path?.startsWith(own) || probed.has(path)) {
        return;
      }

      probed.add(path);
      fetch(path, { method: "HEAD", cache: "no-store" })
        .then((res) => {
          if (res.status === 404 || res.headers.has("x-fx-css-fallback")) {
            recover();
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {});
    };
    const named = (error) =>
